title: The Missing Observatory Key
brief: At 21:10, the dome key vanished. Mara says she stayed in the archive. Elias says he left at 20:55. Connect the suspect to the two clues that establish who borrowed it.
success_text: Case solved: Mara borrowed the key. The camera contradicts her alibi, and her signed note explains why she took it.

cards.title: Mara / Curator
cards.body: She says she stayed in the archive after 21:00.

cards.title: East corridor
cards.body: At 21:08, Mara entered the corridor beside the key desk. Elias left at 20:54.

cards.title: Elias / Technician
cards.body: He says he left the building at 20:55. He planned to return tomorrow.

cards.title: Archive printer
cards.body: Mara sent a print job at 20:47. No later archive activity is recorded.

cards.title: A borrowed key
cards.body: I need the dome tonight. I will return the key before morning. — Mara

cards.title: Empty key hook
cards.body: The key was present at 21:00. At 21:10, its hook was empty.
